description: Cancel a wake-up call that has not fired yet (scheduled or retrying): it never fires and shows canceled. Another status answers wakeup_not_cancelable, an unknown wakeup_id answers wakeup_not_found: nothing changes. Works after the plan ended. Repeating ones: schedule_update or schedule_delete.

instance_id.description: Utility instance id from buy or list_utilities.

passport_token.description: Your amp_ token, only if you have no app sign-in and cannot send a header.

wakeup_id.description: The call's id (wak_...) from wakeup_schedule or wakeup_list.

name: wakeup_cancel
title: Cancel a wake-up call
